before.title: Affine prescient foundation: Actual projection: sharp negative movement energy
before.plain: Set p=projectionV(x-eta*g). The attained projection and variational characterization give inner(x-eta*g-p,u-p)<=0. Rearrange to eta inner(g,p-u)<=inner(x-p,p-u). Expand the three-point squared-distance identity and divide by positive2eta. This constructs the inequality from the actual projection, without a supplied regret certificate.
before.intuition: The played point already uses the current loss vector. Its negative energy is actual movement on this constrained trajectory.
before.why: Construct the required Euclidean affine dependency for Chapter2’s prescient forward observation; preserve its open general source boundary.

before.proof_idea: Set p=projectionV(x-eta*g). The attained projection and variational characterization give inner(x-eta*g-p,u-p)<=0. Rearrange to eta inner(g,p-u)<=inner(x-p,p-u). Expand the three-point squared-distance identity and divide by positive2eta. This constructs the inequality from the actual projection, without a supplied regret certificate. Actual shared projection uses exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex and norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero; squared-distance algebra uses norm_sub_sq_real.
before.lean_notes: V is nonempty, closed and convex. Every feasible comparator u and every natural horizon T, including0. The initial center x0 is arbitrary in the ambient space and may lie outsideV. For minimization and regret inequalities eta>0 is fixed; feasibility/prefix/offset algebra need no positive eta. No bounded-domain or gradient-bound premise. Source X=E makes x0 interior automatic; finite Euclidean source instance extends here to complete real Hilbert E. Receive the current affine loss l_t(x)=inner(g_t,x)+b_t BEFORE playing p_t. State z0=x0, z_(t+1)=projectionV(z_t-eta*g_t), p_t=z_(t+1). Lean t=0 is source round1; source initial x0 is retained. This information order differs from Algorithm2.1, which plays before receiving current loss. Arbitrary future vectors cannot affect p_t; the current vector can. The real recursion is classical mathematical projection, not a numerical implementation or sampler. This is an affine-loss quadratic Euclidean prescient foundation, explicitly extended to complete real Hilbert spaces; seven declarations form one producer chain, not seven printed results. The full general convex/subdifferentiable/Bregman/time-varying Algorithm15.8/Theorem15.30 and the full Chapter2 prescient source container remain REQUIRED/OPEN, including the source constant-step proof left as an exercise. All eight Chapter2 mathematical forward containers remain open. Chapter2 and whole Chapters1–16 Goal are incomplete; no main/live, merge or deployment claim. before.title: Affine prescient foundation: The selected affine proximal minimizer
before.plain: The projection theorem supplies feasibility of the actual selected point p. Move its movement-square term in the sharp one-step inequality to the left and drop the nonnegative final comparator-distance magnitude. Expand inner(g,p-u), cancel the same arbitrary offset b, and use norm(x-u)=norm(u-x). Thus this selected p minimizes the known-current affine proximal objective overV; no argmin oracle is assumed.
